Some brands become part of a country’s memory. Imperial’s story began in 1924. More than a century later, we imagine a new way to discover it.

Museo Imperial is a cultural experience envisioned for La Fortuna: a meeting of design, objects, stories and the unmistakable spirit of Costa Rica.

Pura vida, through time.
